references.text: These verses also describe the Sabbath year, when the land must rest in the seventh year, and what grows on its own is to be left for the poor and wild animals.
The Sabbath command as the basis for resting on the seventh day, which is also extended to apply to the land in the seventh year.
The introduction to the Sabbath year explaining that when the Israelites enter the land, the land must keep a Sabbath for the Lord.
God's promise of blessing in the sixth year to compensate for the Sabbath year when the land must rest.
A warning that the land will receive its Sabbath rest if the people do not observe the Sabbath years—the land will rest while the people are in exile.
The fulfillment of the prophecy that the land would receive its Sabbath rest during the exile in Babylon.
The people's obligation to let the land rest every seventh year after returning from exile.
The Sabbath year is also connected with the forgiveness of debts every seventh year.
